DDInter484.mechanism: INTERVAL: Because sodium zirconium cyclosilicate can transiently increase gastric pH, it may affect the absorption of coadministered medications that exhibit pH-dependent solubility. Altered efficacy or safety of these medications may occur when they are administered too close to the dosing of sodium zirconium cyclosilicate.
